message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code loads data via local utility functions (load_data, load_data_trunc) with no visible remote fetching, checksum verification, or source authentication.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, label value validation, or label-noise detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) is present anywhere in the data preparation flow.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is applied to the training data before it is used for model training.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads model weights (e.g., model.load_weights('output/models/best_gcn') and model.load_state_dict(torch.load('output/models/best_dgi.pkl'))) without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision validation.

No detected label distribution validation: The code loads labels and prints shape information but performs no class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loops across gcn.py, dgi.py, or vgae.py.
No detected differential privacy: Standard Adam optimizers (tf.keras.optimizers.Adam, torch.optim.Adam) are used with no DP-SGD, Opacus, or TensorFlow Privacy mechanisms applied.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the evaluation code; only standard node classification accuracy is measured.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although separate train/val/test masks are used, there is no hashing or signing of evaluation data, no isolation enforcement beyond mask indexing, and only a single accuracy metric is reported without independent verification.

No detected input sanitization: Inputs are loaded directly from dataset files and CLI arguments use argparse choices for the dataset name only; no shape/range checks or schema validation are performed on the actual graph data or features before model inference.
No detected output bounds checks: Embeddings and predictions are used or saved without any NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks on the model outputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: These are graph neural network models (GCN, DGI, VGAE), not LLMs, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
